incident_summary: During batch 092 execution, release candidate manifest and deployment receipt were modified during iterative test refinement, violating append-only governance. Additionally, DEPLOYMENT_RECEIPT_092.json erroneously asserted STAGING_READY_FOR_PUBLIC_DEPLOY without verified live CDN attestation.
governance_remediation_actions: 1. Removed --force flag completely from all release candidate emitters; target file collision is strictly fail-closed.
2. Separated runtime screenshot and evidence generation from test suites; test suites are 100% read-only.
3. Reclassified all pre-deployment receipts as staging-only attestations; deployment receipts with CDN response hash will only be created post-deploy upon explicit CEO command.
4. Enforced strict >=44px touch target verification and reduced mobile DOM height from ~7,000px to ~1,200px via compact expandable Watchlist.
5. Commercial catalog invariants locked: deals_feed.json: [] (is_approved: false).
